Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the hosted demo last week — the execs at Trinity want to explore an isolated deployment (VPC/on-prem, potentially air-gapped) for our PHI workloads. We'd like a focused 60–75 minute architecture review + hands-on demo covering:
- network boundary and ingress patterns for a walled-garden deployment
- KMS/HSM integration options and key rotation flow
- rack/host requirements (GPU/IO/OS images) and offline installer for air-gapped sites
- operational playbooks (patching, telemetry export, maintenance windows)

Can your team run a technical deep-dive next week? Our preferred windows (ET):
- Tue Jul 7, 10:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed Jul 8, 09:00–11:00

Attendees from our side will include platform engineering and security (I can confirm exact names). I'm attaching a short list of initial requirements to help shape the agenda.

Attachment: Trinity_Initial_Requirements.pdf (1 page)

Best,
Emily Ross
